title: Pin the case-fold table digest: a test that fails on drift of unicode-case-folding (DEC-282 (a12) pair item)
description: DEC-282 (a12) (opum-doc, opum-ai/opum-doc#1870 family): the lore/quest pair shares one case-fold table, and a change to it is a pair change with a digest test failing in whichever half lags. lore pins its generated table (digest ef08b22d969b928737ae158c7a0d2bc4b800769b178f99db69f21bd68255fc13 over its generated file). quest has no such test: unicode-case-folding is used only in src/domain/records.ts:1 (caseFold), package.json:83 (^1.1.1) and bun.lock:125, so a lockfile regen resolving 1.1.2 would silently diverge from lore. TEST ONLY: pin the digest of the fold data quest actually uses. Do not change package.json or bun.lock (a dependency path needing a floor check first). The digest is over quest own representation: for every code point 0..0x10FFFF excluding surrogates, lookupFolding(cp) when defined, one line per entry "<cp hex>:<mapped hex,...>\n" in code point order, sha256; 1585 entries at 1.1.1.

acceptanceCriteria.text: A test pins the sha256 of the lookupFolding table of the installed unicode-case-folding (1585 entries at 1.1.1), stating exactly what it hashes
The test goes red when the table drifts (shown by a mutant that perturbs one entry or the entry count)
No change to package.json or bun.lock
